title: Fort Dearborn monument: Black Partridge's fringed breechcloth, the child's smock
items: On the Fort Dearborn monument (18th Street, 1904), Black Partridge's breechcloth is now a short apron off his belt, cut into a ragged fringe at the tops of his thighs. Both photographs show it that way. Before, it hung to his knee.
The kneeling child now wears the short smock the bronze shows, with bare arms, shins and feet, instead of a jacket and trousers.
